chapters.title: RTO and RPO as business decisions
Identity, security and rapid fire round

takeaways: Resilience and high availability are different: a resilient system bends and recovers under stress, while high availability fails over to a second instance elsewhere.
No solution reaches 100% uptime because the composite SLA is the product of all dependent services, so define RTO and RPO with the business and design multi-region where it pays off.
Use the Azure Well-Architected Framework, mission-critical guidance and fault injection with Azure Chaos Studio, and keep designs simple instead of defaulting to Kubernetes.
hook: Azure architecture is easy when everything works; the real questions start when regions, dependencies and assumptions fail. In this episode, Microsoft MVP Mike Martin helps Azure architects and IT decision-makers tell resilience from high availability, set realistic SLA, RTO and RPO targets, and understand where Microsoft's responsibility ends. You get practical guidance on multi-region design, chaos testing and keeping solutions simple.
